MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 9
   C. 32
   D. 8

2. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)

   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 2

3. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

5. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/4
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/2

6. What is √49? (1 mark)

   B. 43

   D. 2

10. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
